notes.title: TRON: Catalyst Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]> RUN[/p][p]> TRON_CATALYST_UPDATE[/p][p]
[/p][p]Greetings, User. [/p][p]
[/p][p]The Arq Grid has received a patch, modifying the prices of the Parry skill tree.[/p][p]
[/p][list][*][p]Increased cost of Parry Window (was 1000, now 1500)[/p][/*][*][p]Increased cost of Parry Damage  (was 750, now 2000)[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][p]In addition to these changes, the following bugs have been derezzed: [/p][p]
[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could potentially become progress blocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players and enemy Light Cycles could fall out of the map.[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3025590/TRON_Catalyst"][/dynamiclink][/p]
